Back when Karri ran the app, he had a solo coder from India who was a machine—he’d fix my issues in 5 minutes. Now, it's just bloated bureaucracy. They’ve likely overhired people who have no idea what they’re talking about. They’re asking me for hundreds of screenshots just to even begin looking into a problem.
